name: Hari Raya Aidilfitri
description: A vibrant celebration marking the end of Ramadan with open houses, traditional Malay delicacies like ketupat and rendang, and colourful traditional attire.

name: Chinese New Year
description: The most important festival for Malaysian Chinese, featuring lion dances, firecrackers, reunion dinners, and ang pow (red packets) for good fortune.

name: Deepavali
description: The Hindu Festival of Lights celebrated with oil lamps, colourful kolam decorations, traditional Indian sweets, and cultural performances.

name: Thaipusam
description: A spectacular Hindu festival where devotees carry kavadis up 272 steps to Batu Caves as an act of penance and devotion to Lord Murugan.

name: Rainforest World Music Festival
description: An annual three-day music festival held at the Sarawak Cultural Village, featuring world music performances from international and local artists amidst lush rainforest.

name: Penang International Food Festival
description: A month-long celebration of Penang's world-famous street food, featuring food trails, cooking demonstrations, and night markets showcasing diverse culinary traditions.

name: Pesta Kaamatan
description: The Kadazandusun harvest festival celebrating the rice harvest with traditional dances, buffalo races, beauty pageants, and the iconic Unduk Ngadau competition.

name: Gawai Dayak
description: A vibrant Dayak harvest festival celebrated with traditional longhouse gatherings, tuak (rice wine), ngajat dances, and community feasting.

name: Malaysia Water Festival
description: A series of exciting water-based events including dragon boat races, sandcastle competitions, and beach sports held at various coastal destinations.

name: George Town Festival
description: A month-long celebration of arts and culture in the UNESCO World Heritage city, featuring theatre, dance, music, visual arts, and street performances.

name: Putrajaya International Hot Air Balloon Fiesta
description: A spectacular balloon festival featuring colourful hot air balloons from around the world, night glow shows, and family-friendly activities.

name: Langkawi International Maritime & Aerospace Exhibition
description: One of Asia's premier aerospace and maritime exhibitions featuring thrilling air shows, aircraft displays, and naval demonstrations.
